picks.name: Lucky Shot
picks.annotation: Great for damage and ammo, replaces Stalker.

picks.name: Crippling Headshot
picks.annotation: Best item in the game for damage as it shreds resists so your entire team will do more damage. And anti-heal is so good.

picks.name: Colossus
picks.annotation: Melee damadge and tankiness. Pick between this and Ethereal Shift for your last active slot.

picks.name: Indomitable
picks.annotation: Feels nice, I usually get if I bought a barrier item earlier in the game.

picks.name: Juggernaut
picks.annotation: Great against gun carries and is good to pick up if you have no free slots.

picks.name: Phantom Strike
picks.annotation: Good for shutting down fliers and gun carries. And for getting on top of the people you need to target in team fights.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Anti-heal + more burst damage. If you need to burst carries or need anti-heal this is really useful.

picks.name: Scourge
picks.annotation: Usually after Arctic Blast. Makes you really tanky and can do a lot of damage if you get into the middle of their team. Boundless is a good alternative here.

picks.name: Escalating Exposure
picks.annotation: This with Scourge is good. You run into the middle of the enemy team with Scourge and this does work. Also has shred and gives you even more spirit resist so you're even tankier.

picks.name: Transcendent Cooldown
picks.annotation: Great item once you have 2 actives. It also makes Torment Pulse tick faster!

picks.name: Ethereal Shift
picks.annotation: They doubled the CD on it so it's way worse, still might be good though on Calico. Helps you live much longer. Great with Transcendent CD. You can skip for more damage if you're not dying.

picks.name: Focus Lens
picks.annotation: It's fine, good with your burst and the silence is nice.

picks.name: Boundless Spirit
picks.annotation: Gives you some much needed damage in the late game with your ult and gloom bombs. Great if you are trying to oneshot their carries.

picks.name: Hunter's Aura
picks.annotation: Great for 1v1s. Gets you your 4.8k weapon investment. Shadow Weave and Point Blank are also good options, or buy Mystic Shot + Spirit Shredder Bullets if you have the slots.

picks.name: Stalker
picks.annotation: Great damage and stats in lane and gives you move speed for chasing. The foostep sound reduction is also nice. And this gives you wallhacks from the DoT. This is also for the weapon investment bonus.

picks.name: Fleetfoot
picks.annotation: Not as good since the speed stacking nerf. I still like it though. Good for movespeed in ult and catform. Combine with a 3.2k weapon item to get your 4.8k investment spike.

source_builds.name: I love cat[girl]s! Skelly's Spirit Assassin Build

1437614329.annotation: Very common buy. Great healing in lane from punching minions. And we can optionally upgrade this into Lifestrike for more sustain.

98582110.annotation: Great damage and stats in lane and gives you move speed for chasing. The foostep sound reduction is also nice. And this gives you wallhacks from the DoT. This is also for the weapon investment bonus.

3399065363.annotation: Must buy for rotating around the map and ganking other lanes. Builds into Enduring Speed for our Vitality investment spike.

3074274290.annotation: I think might be really good at the moment. Roam a lot once you get it to build up those stacks.

465043967.annotation: We upgrade this to Spirit Snatch later. Adds to our burst and trades with our 2.

1976391348.annotation: Adds to your burst damage, and the slow is great. We also can upgrade this into Arctic Blast.

395944548.annotation: Great damage over the course of a game/fight. Good for tankiness and farming. Gets us our 4.8k spirit investment. I personally prefer it over Spirit Snatch as it does better in longer trades.

2447176615.annotation: Swap this out for Dispel Magic or a situational vitality 1.6k item most games. Great for move speed in fights and the slow resist. Lets you much more easily get the second ult damage proc off.

1342610602.annotation: Worth going early now for Point Blank if you prefer that. Nice for melee resist as well. If you want to kill minions and objectives, its as good as Monster Rounds.

1710079648.annotation: Great for healing if you get really low in lane. Sprint speed is also nice for rotating. If you're going to buy one of these situational healing items, this one stays useful after laning phase.

4204808176.annotation: Great against Viscous in lane since it works against Viscous Puddle Punches. Also a very good item against people building melee (Abrams and Billy). Only buy if you can actually parry consistently.

1672893796.annotation: It's really nice for trades and upgrades into lots of good options.

1252627263.annotation: So much fun. Use off CD with heavy melee in lane for a 100 health heal on a 4 sec CD. Lets you permafight/push in lane. Slow is super good as well.

3633614685.annotation: Gets you your 4.8k vitality spike. You can build this into Fortitude or Colossus. You can buy this earlier during laning to help with survivability. If you went Dispel Magic already, skip this.

3585132399.annotation: The health is great for survivability, the move speed is great for rotating, and the heal lets you stay on the map longer. I prefer this over VW cause it works in the tunnels. Or go Dispel Magic here.

3812615317.annotation: Really great item, great for catching people and for clearing waves in cat form.
